suite: V-REC-01 — Recovery_Mode: authority corruption vs. isolated derived-only degradation

sections.name: Authority schema checksum corruption → RecoveryMode
sections.description: Corrupt schema_version checksum for migration 1. compose() detects SchemaChecksumMismatch via StartupIntegrityChecker → RecoveryMode entered. authority_state() == RecoveryMode(_).
sections.invariant: Authority schema corruption → StartupIntegrityChecker fails → RecoveryMode. No durable writes allowed.

sections.name: Event checksum corruption → deep checker detects Corrupt
sections.description: Insert event with empty payload_checksum. Startup passes (checksum not a startup check). RecoveryIntegrityChecker.check_event_checksum_coverage detects EventChecksumMissing → CapabilityState::Corrupt.
sections.invariant: Event checksum corruption detected by deep checker as CapabilityState::Corrupt.

sections.name: Graph-revision order gap → RecoveryMode
sections.description: Insert revisions 1 and 3 (skipping 2). StartupIntegrityChecker::check_graph_revision_continuity detects gap via COUNT/MIN/MAX analysis → RecoveryMode.
sections.invariant: Graph revision gap (1→3, missing 2) → RecoveryMode entered.

sections.name: Authority_meta singleton violation → startup checker detects
sections.description: Empty authority_meta table (bare rusqlite connection) triggers singleton check violation. Fresh KRIA DB passes as positive control. StartupIntegrityChecker::check_authority_singleton() verified directly.
sections.invariant: Empty authority_meta table → singleton check detects count != 1 → violation.

sections.name: RecoveryMode write-guard: all durable writes blocked
sections.description: Schema corruption triggers RecoveryMode. remember() and observe() both return MemoryError::InRecoveryMode. health().recovery_mode == true with non-empty diagnostic description and fault_class.
sections.invariant: RecoveryMode blocks all durable writes with InRecoveryMode error. health() exposes policy-safe diagnostic.

sections.name: FTS manifest corruption → authority Healthy, FTS Partial
sections.description: Stale algorithm_version in derived_manifests for FTS. compose() does not inspect derived_manifests → Healthy. Writes succeed. deep_check with expected version → CapabilityState::Partial with ManifestVersionMismatch fault.
sections.invariant: Isolated FTS manifest corruption: authority stays Healthy, deep_check returns Partial (not Corrupt).

sections.name: Vector manifest corruption → authority Healthy, vectors Partial
sections.description: Stale model_version in derived_manifests for vector index. compose() stays Healthy, writes succeed. deep_check with expected model_version → CapabilityState::Partial with ManifestVersionMismatch fault. health().recovery_mode == false.
sections.invariant: Isolated vector manifest corruption: authority stays Healthy, deep_check returns Partial (not Corrupt).

key_invariants.authority_corruption_enters_recovery_mod: Schema checksum mismatch, revision gap, or singleton violation → StartupIntegrityChecker fails → RecoveryMode. All durable writes blocked.
key_invariants.recovery_mode_write_guard: remember() and observe() return MemoryError::InRecoveryMode in RecoveryMode. health() exposes fault_class and description (no protected data).
key_invariants.derived_only_corruption_stays_healthy: Stale FTS/vector manifests in derived_manifests never trigger RecoveryMode. Authority remains Healthy, writes succeed.
key_invariants.deep_check_partial_for_derived: RecoveryIntegrityChecker detects stale manifest versions as CapabilityState::Partial (not Corrupt). stale_manifest_count >= 1.
key_invariants.isolation_invariant: Authority integrity failures and derived projection degradation are fully isolated. One cannot mask the other.
